comment: Read from the installed 2.0.5 build. Every module in this plugin scales its inputs by 0.1 and its outputs by 10 on the way in and out of the DSP, so a full-scale internal value of 1 is 10V at the jack. The channel count is the largest number of channels on the signal input, limited to 16, and is recomputed every 32 samples. No family is given to the signal jacks because a slew limiter passes whatever it is given.
